editor.label: Save name
editor.description: The world the server loads (the folder saves/<name>). A new name starts a new world of the world type below. Letters, digits and _ only, up to 32 characters.

editor.label: World type (new worlds)
editor.description: Only used when the save does not exist yet: a new world of this type is created (Normal difficulty; the difficulty console command changes it). An existing save keeps its own world.

editor.label: Listed in the server list
editor.description: Registers the server on the game's master server. Players can always join by address.

editor.label: Pause when empty
editor.description: The world stops while nobody is online.

editor.label: Disconnect timeout (ms)
editor.description: How long a silent client stays connected.

editor.label: Admin secret
editor.description: Players who set the same secret in their game (Settings) can run server commands with serverrun <command> in their console. Leave empty to turn it off. Letters, digits and . _ ~ + = - only.

editor.label: Server name
editor.description: Shown in the in-game server list. No < > & characters.

editor.label: Join password
editor.description: Leave empty for no password. No < > & characters.

editor.label: Listed in the server list
editor.description: Registers the server on the game's master server. Players can always join by address.

editor.label: Pause when empty
editor.description: The world stops while nobody is online.

editor.label: Disconnect timeout (ms)
editor.description: How long a silent client stays connected.

script.name: Stationeers query
script.description: Reports the server online while it answers a RakNet ping on its game port (Stationeers has no Steam query).

script.name: Graceful stop
script.description: Saves the world (save), waits for the new save file, then quits the server (quit). quit alone does not save.

script.name: Add the Workshop mod to the mods folder
script.description: Copies the downloaded Workshop mod to mods/workshop-<id> (the server loads it at its next start). Never follows links.

script.name: Remove the Workshop mod from the mods folder
